d:
Chhathi maiya ki jay! jay chhathi maiya!
Chhath mahaparv ke pavan avsar par sunie anuradha paudval ki madhur vani men chhathi maiya aur sury dev ki aaradhna se saje paranprik chhath puja gita. in bhaktimay git men chhath vrat ki shraddha, arghy ki paranpra aur chhathi maiya ke prati atut vishvas ki jhalak milti hai.
Chhath Pooja Geet: Dohri Kalsupve Savita
Singer: ANURADHA PAUDWAL
Music Director: Sunil Chhaila Bihari
Lyricist: Rama Mausam
Album: Chhathi Maiya Hamaar
Music Label: T-Series
